# Component parameter reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/ci/api_reference.py; do not edit tables by hand. -->

All **79 renderer contracts** below are supported by the native Compose and HTML providers. Wasm uses the Compose UI provider. See [platform behavior and limits](coverage.md) and [Material variants](material-catalog.md).

Feature code can use direct arguments. These tables describe the canonical `Props` models; direct overloads add `modifier` and composable content slots where appropriate. The linked API pages contain all overloads and related appearance types.

## Parameter conventions

- Values and selection are controlled by the app; callbacks report requested changes.
- Form controls inherit an enclosing disabled form state.
- `label`, `description` and image descriptions provide accessible naming; visual headings are explicit.
- A null `appearance` uses the family theme style. Copy that style for a partial override.
- `modifier` configures layout/drawing/semantics; content and icon slots accept shared composables.

## DomposableDataTable

Core / additional controls. [Full API and overloads](https://samuolis.github.io/domposable/api/domposable-ui/io.github.samuolis.domposable.ui/-domposable-data-table.html) · [Props API](https://samuolis.github.io/domposable/api/domposable-ui/io.github.samuolis.domposable.ui/-domposable-data-table-props/index.html) · [Source](https://github.com/samuolis/domposable/blob/main/domposable-ui/src/commonMain/kotlin/io/github/samuolis/domposable/ui/DataDisplays.kt#L130)

| Parameter | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | <code>List&lt;<a href="https://samuolis.github.io/domposable/api/domposable-ui/io.github.samuolis.domposable.ui/-domposable-data-table-column/index.html">DomposableDataTableColumn</a>&gt;</code> | **Required** |
| `rows` | <code>List&lt;<a href="https://samuolis.github.io/domposable/api/domposable-ui/io.github.samuolis.domposable.ui/-domposable-data-table-row/index.html">DomposableDataTableRow</a>&gt;</code> | **Required** |
| `sizePreset` | <code><a href="https://samuolis.github.io/domposable/api/domposable-ui/io.github.samuolis.domposable.ui/-domposable-data-table-size/index.html">DomposableDataTableSize</a></code> | `DomposableDataTableSize.Standard` |
| `rowHeaderColumnKey` | <code>String?</code> | `null` |
| `allowHorizontalOverflow` | <code>Boolean</code> | `true` |
| `onRowActivate` | <code>(String) -&gt; Unit?</code> | `null` |
| `cellAction` | <code>(rowKey: String, columnKey: String) -&gt; () -&gt; Unit?</code> | `{ _, _ -> null }` |
| `appearance` | <code><a href="https://samuolis.github.io/domposable/api/domposable-foundation/io.github.samuolis.domposable.foundation/-domposable-table-appearance/index.html">DomposableTableAppearance</a>?</code> | `null` |
| `cellContent` | <code>@Composable (row: <a href="https://samuolis.github.io/domposable/api/domposable-ui/io.github.samuolis.domposable.ui/-domposable-data-table-row/index.html">DomposableDataTableRow</a>, column: <a href="https://samuolis.github.io/domposable/api/domposable-ui/io.github.samuolis.domposable.ui/-domposable-data-table-column/index.html">DomposableDataTableColumn</a>) -&gt; Unit</code> | **Required** |

`DomposableTableAppearance.rowSpacing` and `columnSpacing` optionally set the gaps between table rows and columns.
They default to `null`, preserving each renderer's existing size-preset layout. In Compact mode, `rowSpacing` sets
the gap between visible row tracks (including a rendered header), card rows and fields within each card, while
`columnSpacing` sets the label-to-value gap inside each card.

```kotlin
val tableAppearance = DomposableTableAppearance(
    rowSpacing = 0.dp,
    columnSpacing = 8.dp,
    cellPadding = DomposableInsets(top = 4.dp, bottom = 4.dp),
)

DomposableDataTable(
    columns = listOf(DomposableDataTableColumn("name", "Name")),
    rows = listOf(DomposableDataTableRow("Ada Lovelace")),
    rowHeaderColumnKey = "name",
    appearance = tableAppearance,
) { row, _ ->
    DomposableText(row.key)
}
```
